title: The Landstar Link, Spring 2021
summary: Read about Landstar Agent Award winners, including the newest members of the Chief Executive’s Circle, Landstar industry awards and employee recognitions.
body_markdown:
The Landstar Link, Spring 2021 newsletter is now available! In this issue, you will read about:


- Landstar Agent Award winners, including the newest members of the Chief Executive’s Circle
- The recipients of the 2021-2022 Landstar Scholarship Fund
- Landstar industry awards and employee recognitions
- The winners of the *Countdown to Roadcheck* contest
- *Being Your Own Boss* - a new episode of The Road to Success® podcast


#### [Click here to read the publication today.](https://cloud.3dissue.net/29953/29847/30285/54895/index.html?77707)
